card.name: Spaces before numbers in chemo regimens
card.fires_on: A space or digit right before a number in dosing text for fluorouracil, leucovorin and oxaliplatin regimens, such as after mg/m, 'to', 'x', 'Day' or 'Figure'.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space between a unit or label and the number that follows it.
modes.example: followed by 5-fluorouracil at 370 mg/m<< >>2 by intravenous injection.

modes.label: Section digit
modes.description: The digit in a section cross-reference like (2.4) in the dosing section.
modes.example: if the patient has recovered from toxicity from the prior course. ( <<2>>.4 ) Do not adjust KHAP

modes.label: Slash between drugs
modes.description: The slash joining drug names in a combination regimen.
modes.example: Administer oxaliplatin for injection in combination with 5-fluorouracil<</>>leucovorin every 2

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to write drug names starting with fluor, lut or Ce, as in fluorouracil or leucovorin.
card.plain: It fires on small spacing marks and digits inside chemotherapy dosing lines for fluorouracil and leucovorin.
